subject: English
story: Good morning Class I! Listen carefully to my instructions. First, open your book to page five. Next, draw a small blue star next to the heading. Then read the three sentences aloud. After that, circle the picture of a red bus. Finally, close your book and wait for the bell. Great job, everyone!
story_audio: Listen to the story carefully. You need to arrange the steps in the CORRECT ORDER.
instructions: Listen to the story. Then arrange the steps in the CORRECT ORDER.
correct_sequence: 📖 Open your book to page five
⭐ Draw a small blue star next to the heading
🚌 Circle the picture of a red bus
📚 Close your book and wait for the bell
all_steps_shuffled: 📚 Close your book and wait for the bell
📖 Open your book to page five
🚌 Circle the picture of a red bus
⭐ Draw a small blue star next to the heading

game_flow.step_4: Student DRAG & DROP to arrange in correct order
